name: rows_in_sales
expression: COUNTROWS(Sales)

name: Total Sales
expression:
SUMX(
    Sales, 
    Sales[Order qty] * Sales[unit price] 
    )

name: Total Cost
expression:
SUMX(
    Sales,
    Sales[Order qty] * Sales[unit cost] 
)

name: Total Profit
expression: [Total Sales] - [Total Cost]

name: Total Orders
expression: SUM( Sales[Order qty] )

name: Profit Margin %
expression:
DIVIDE(
    [Total Profit],
    [Total Sales]
    )

name: another approach _ Total Sales PM
expression:
IF( 
    [Total Sales] = BLANK(),
    BLANK(),
    CALCULATE(
        [Total Sales],
        PARALLELPERIOD('Date Table'[Date], -1, MONTH ) 
        )
)

name: WOW diff %
expression:
DIVIDE(
    ([Total Sales Current Week] - [Total Sales Previous Week]),
    [Total Sales Previous Week]
)

name: Total Sales Previous Week
expression:
CALCULATE(
    [Total Sales],
    KEEPFILTERS('Date Table'[WeeknYear] = MAX('Date Table'[WeeknYear]) - 1 )
)

name: Target Format
expression: FORMAT( [Target +0.2 of Previous month] / 1000000 , "$#.00M")

name: TS PM Previous
expression:
VAR _datetable =
 DATESINPERIOD( 
    'Date Table'[Date], MAX(Sales[Sales Date]), -1, MONTH )
VAR _result =
CALCULATE(
    [Total Sales],
    PREVIOUSMONTH(_datetable)
    )
RETURN _result

name: TS PM Current
expression:
VAR _datetable =
 DATESINPERIOD( 
    'Date Table'[Date], MAX(Sales[Sales Date]), -1, MONTH )
VAR _result =
CALCULATE(
    [Total Sales],
    _datetable
    )
RETURN _result

name: TS MOM diff %
expression:
DIVIDE(
    ([TS PM Current] - [TS PM Previous]),
    [TS PM Previous]
    )

name: Total profit fx
expression: [Total Profit]

name: Color Formatting Line Chart
expression:
VAR _BottumColors = "#FA0C27" 
VAR _TopColors = "#1800ED"
VAR _MiddleColor = "#B6B1AF"
VAR _Result = 
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    [Total Sales] > [Higher Percentile of Dates], _TopColors,
    [Total Sales] < [Lower Percentile of Dates], _BottumColors,
    _MiddleColor
    )
RETURN _Result

name: Median of Dates
expression:
VAR _table = FILTER( ALLSELECTED('Date Table'), 'Date Table'[Date] <= [max date] )
VAR _Result = MEDIANX( _table , [Total Sales] )
RETURN _Result

name: Higher Percentile of Dates
expression:
VAR _highPth = 'Higher Percentile'[Higher Percentile Value]
VAR _Result =
    SWITCH (
        TRUE (),
        ISINSCOPE ( 'Date Table'[Date] ), PERCENTILEX.EXC ( ALL( 'Date Table'[Date] ), [Total Sales], _highPth ),
        ISINSCOPE ( 'Date Table'[Month Short] ),
            PERCENTILEX.EXC (
                ALL( 'Date Table'[Month Short] ),
                [Total Sales],
                _highPth
            ),
        ISINSCOPE ( 'Date Table'[WeeknYear] ),
            PERCENTILEX.EXC (
                ALL( 'Date Table'[WeeknYear] ),
                [Total Sales],
                _highPth
            )
    )
RETURN
    _Result

name: Lower Percentile of Dates
expression:
VAR _LowerPth = 'Lower Percentile'[Lower Percentile Value]
VAR _Result =
    SWITCH (
        TRUE (),
        ISINSCOPE ( 'Date Table'[Date] ), PERCENTILEX.EXC ( ALL( 'Date Table'[Date] ), [Total Sales], _LowerPth ),
        ISINSCOPE ( 'Date Table'[Month Short] ),
            PERCENTILEX.EXC (
                ALL( 'Date Table'[Month Short] ),
                [Total Sales],
                _LowerPth
            ),
        ISINSCOPE ( 'Date Table'[WeeknYear] ),
            PERCENTILEX.EXC (
                ALL( 'Date Table'[WeeknYear] ),
                [Total Sales],
                _LowerPth
            )
    )
RETURN
    _Result

name: max date
expression: MAX( Sales[Sales Date] )

name: Average Daily Sales
expression:
VAR _table = ALLSELECTED('Date Table')
VAR _Result = AVERAGEX( _table , [Total Sales] )
RETURN _Result

name: Lower Percentile Value
expression: SELECTEDVALUE('Lower Percentile'[Lower Percentile], 0.25)

name: Higher Percentile Value
expression: SELECTEDVALUE('Higher Percentile'[Higher Percentile], 0.75)

name: Title dynamic
expression:
VAR _selected = SELECTEDVALUE( 'Date M-W-D'[Date M-W-D Order] )
VAR _result =
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    _selected = 0, "day",
    _selected = 1, "week",
    _selected = 2, "month",
    "day"
)
RETURN _result

name: ranking_asc
expression:
var _ra =
 RANKX( 
     ALL(Products_Data),
     [Total Sales], , ASC, Skip )
var _if =
 IF( _ra <= 'Number of Rows'[Parameter Value] , [Total Sales], BLANK() ) 
return _if

name: ranking_desc
expression:
var _ra =
 RANKX( 
     ALL(Products_Data),
     [Total Sales], , DESC, Skip )
var _if =
 IF( _ra <= 'Number of Rows'[Parameter Value] , [Total Sales] ,BLANK() )  
return _if
